caveats: The 848 released paper set codes outside expansion/core include supplemental, tokens, promos and numerous non-premier product families; they are not 848 standalone booster sets.
The 12 reviewed outside-category records are bounded examples, not a certification of every code in the 848-code discovery pool.
The 136 reviewed expansion/core regular/mainline codes remain a category-specific count, not a universal 1993–2026 premier census.
Wizards' 2022 premier/Standard definition and 2025 forward-only Universes Beyond policy must both be applied with dated context.
Neither Scryfall set_type nor mere Modern legality proves an item to be a premier release.
Specialist sources corroborate FBB/4BB localized edition relationships but the project still lacks direct Wizards verification; those statuses remain provisional.
This is a dated October 29, 2026 catalog, not a current live legality or product count.

localized_printing_variants.notes: Cardmarket describes localized black-bordered Revised editions with their base edition card pool, not an independent regular core edition.
Cardmarket describes localized Fourth Edition black-bordered printings in new languages, not a different base edition.

premier_policy.policy_note: 2025-and-later Universes Beyond main booster content becomes Standard legal, but the change is forward-only and does not alter 2023 LTR or 2024 ACR.
premier_policy.section: Premier sets described as the four major yearly Standard-format releases in 2022; Masters, Modern Horizons, Secret Lair, UB discussed separately.
